summary: Clean on the MEM dimension. _sqlite_hooks.py is a thin pointer-passing layer: six @proxy wrappers that forward db/callback/context pointers to the SQLite hook-registration functions via _call_lib_func. It contains no @cfunc callback bodies (so no exception-swallow / NRT-leak surface), no NRT/meminfo refcount handling, and only scalar (intp/int32/void) signatures (no struct-by-value, no sret, no eightbyte repack). cfunc lifetime and the @cfunc exception/error-signaling contract are explicitly and correctly delegated to the caller in the module docstring.
